tasks.title: Upload content in parts

states.label: finish received; checking size and sha256

properties.name: Writes never wait for another island
properties.expression: every UploadStart, UploadPart and UploadFinish is answered by this shard with no Shard-to-Peer message caused by it
properties.formula: AG atom("every UploadStart, UploadPart and UploadFinish is answered by this shard with no Shard-to-Peer message caused by it")

properties.name: Parts resume
properties.expression: an UploadRejected for a part names the offset the shard holds, and parts sent from that offset complete the upload
properties.formula: AG atom("an UploadRejected for a part names the offset the shard holds, and parts sent from that offset complete the upload")

tasks.interaction_mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Browser
    participant Shard
    Browser->>Shard: UploadStart
    alt choice 1
    Shard->>Browser: UploadRejected
    else alternative
    Shard->>Browser: UploadStarted
    loop repeat
    Browser->>Shard: UploadPart
    alt choice 1
    Shard->>Browser: UploadPartAck
    else alternative
    Shard->>Browser: UploadRejected
    end
    end
    Browser->>Shard: UploadFinish
    alt choice 1
    Shard->>Browser: UploadResponse
    else alternative
    Shard->>Browser: UploadRejected
    end
    end
tasks.state_mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> ready
    ready --> requested: UploadStart
    requested --> open: UploadStarted
    requested --> rejected: UploadRejected
    open --> sending: UploadPart
    sending --> open: UploadPartAck
    sending --> open: UploadRejected
    open --> finishing: UploadFinish
    finishing --> stored: UploadResponse
    finishing --> rejected: UploadRejected
    stored --> [*]
    rejected --> [*]

tasks.title: Write a new version

properties.name: Updates are never refused for being stale
properties.expression: UpdateRejected when this shard holds every (id, d) in prev_dts
properties.formula: AG ¬atom("UpdateRejected when this shard holds every (id, d) in prev_dts")

properties.name: Writes need write
properties.expression: an UpdateResponse or an UploadResponse for an existing id follows only a request whose caller the file's governing policy gives write = true; an UploadResponse for a new file only one the folder's policy gives write = true
properties.formula: AG atom("an UpdateResponse or an UploadResponse for an existing id follows only a request whose caller the file's governing policy gives write = true; an UploadResponse for a new file only one the folder's policy gives write = true")

    Browser->>Shard: UpdateRequest
    alt choice 1
    Shard->>Browser: UpdateResponse
    else alternative
    Shard->>Browser: UpdateRejected
    end
tasks.state_mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> ready
    ready --> requested: UpdateRequest
    requested --> stored: UpdateResponse
    requested --> rejected: UpdateRejected
    stored --> [*]
    rejected --> [*]

tasks.title: Page through what this shard can show

properties.name: Feed pages are complete
properties.expression: a browser that starts at after_visible_dt = 0 and follows last_visible_dt receives every record this shard holds that its token may read, each at least once
properties.formula: AG atom("a browser that starts at after_visible_dt = 0 and follows last_visible_dt receives every record this shard holds that its token may read, each at least once")

properties.name: Every shown file carries its label
properties.expression: every record in FeedResponse has the decision Eval(jwt, governing rego) for this caller, with read = true
properties.formula: AG atom("every record in FeedResponse has the decision Eval(jwt, governing rego) for this caller, with read = true")

properties.name: The page banner is the most restrictive shown
properties.expression: page_banner is the decision of greatest rank in the same FeedResponse, and the page shows it at the top and the bottom
properties.formula: AG atom("page_banner is the decision of greatest rank in the same FeedResponse, and the page shows it at the top and the bottom")

properties.name: Same view everywhere after replication
properties.expression: two shards holding the same records answer the same token with the same readable files, the same latest version of each, and the same decisions
properties.formula: AG atom("two shards holding the same records answer the same token with the same readable files, the same latest version of each, and the same decisions")

tasks.interaction_mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Browser
    participant Shard
    Browser->>Shard: FeedRequest
    alt choice 1
    Shard->>Browser: FeedResponse
    else alternative
    Shard->>Browser: AccessDenied
    end
tasks.state_mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> ready
    ready --> requested: FeedRequest
    requested --> rendered: FeedResponse
    requested --> denied: AccessDenied
    rendered --> [*]
    denied --> [*]

tasks.title: Download one version

states.label: token rejected, or the file is hidden or absent

properties.name: Ranges are exact
properties.expression: a DownloadResponse for a range carries exactly bytes [range_start, range_end) of the blob and its total_size
properties.formula: AG atom("a DownloadResponse for a range carries exactly bytes [range_start, range_end) of the blob and its total_size")

properties.name: Ranges are always honoured
properties.expression: a DownloadRequest with a satisfiable range, asked for or not by the user, is answered 206; one without a range 200; both say Accept-Ranges: bytes; HEAD answers the same headers without a body
properties.formula: AG atom("a DownloadRequest with a satisfiable range, asked for or not by the user, is answered 206; one without a range 200; both say Accept-Ranges: bytes; HEAD answers the same headers without a body")

tasks.interaction_mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Browser
    participant Shard
    Browser->>Shard: DownloadRequest
    alt choice 1
    Shard->>Browser: DownloadResponse
    else alternative
    Shard->>Browser: RangeNotSatisfiable
    else alternative
    Shard->>Browser: AccessDenied
    end
tasks.state_mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> ready
    ready --> requested: DownloadRequest
    requested --> served: DownloadResponse
    requested --> unsatisfiable: RangeNotSatisfiable
    requested --> denied: AccessDenied
    served --> [*]
    unsatisfiable --> [*]
    denied --> [*]

tasks.title: Record anti-entropy with one peer

states.label: peer did not answer; retry on the next timer

properties.name: Anti-entropy is idempotent
properties.expression: a RecordsResponse delivered twice, or in any order, leaves the same records on the receiving shard
properties.formula: AG atom("a RecordsResponse delivered twice, or in any order, leaves the same records on the receiving shard")

properties.name: Converge after repair
properties.expression: once peers answer each other, every record held by any shard is held by every shard
properties.formula: AF atom("once peers answer each other, every record held by any shard is held by every shard")

properties.name: Delivery is at least once
properties.expression: a record may be delivered to a shard more than once, after a restart or a lost response; storing it again changes nothing visible
properties.formula: AG atom("a record may be delivered to a shard more than once, after a restart or a lost response; storing it again changes nothing visible")

tasks.interaction_mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Shard
    participant Peer
    Shard->>Peer: IHaveRequest
    alt choice 1
    Shard->>Shard: PeerTimedOut
    else alternative
    Peer->>Shard: IHaveResponse
    loop repeat
    Shard->>Peer: RecordsRequest
    alt choice 1
    Peer->>Shard: RecordsResponse
    else alternative
    Shard->>Shard: PeerTimedOut
    end
    end
    end
tasks.state_mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> idle
    idle --> asked: IHaveRequest
    asked --> known: IHaveResponse
    asked --> unreachable: PeerTimedOut
    known --> pulling: RecordsRequest
    pulling --> known: RecordsResponse
    pulling --> unreachable: PeerTimedOut
    known --> done: IHaveRequest
    done --> [*]
    unreachable --> [*]

tasks.title: Import one record with its blob

states.label: record pulled, waiting for a lane
peer missing or unreachable; back in the queue at the offset held

properties.name: Imports resume
properties.expression: after a PeerTimedOut, the next BlobRequest for that blob starts at the offset already held
properties.formula: AG atom("after a PeerTimedOut, the next BlobRequest for that blob starts at the offset already held")

properties.name: Imports are bounded
properties.expression: at most 128 imports from one shard are in flight, at most 96 of them for blobs over 64 MiB, and a RecordsRequest is sent only while fewer than 100000 pulled records wait for a lane
properties.formula: AG atom("at most 128 imports from one shard are in flight, at most 96 of them for blobs over 64 MiB, and a RecordsRequest is sent only while fewer than 100000 pulled records wait for a lane")

properties.name: A failing import yields its lane
properties.expression: after a PeerTimedOut, BlobMissing or failed verification, the import releases its lane and is queued again only after a backoff of 1 s doubling to 10 min; it resumes at the offset already held
properties.formula: AG atom("after a PeerTimedOut, BlobMissing or failed verification, the import releases its lane and is queued again only after a backoff of 1 s doubling to 10 min; it resumes at the offset already held")

properties.name: Other imports progress while one fails
properties.expression: while some imports keep failing, every queued import that can succeed starts and finishes
properties.formula: AF atom("while some imports keep failing, every queued import that can succeed starts and finishes")

properties.name: Short files always open a lane
properties.expression: a queued import of a blob of at most 64 MiB starts before any running import of a larger blob finishes
properties.formula: AG atom("a queued import of a blob of at most 64 MiB starts before any running import of a larger blob finishes")

properties.name: The cursor jumps when the run completes
properties.expression: when the import of the lowest unfinished record of a peer's feed commits, the cursor for that peer moves in the same commit to the highest peer visible_dt below which every pulled record is imported; no other commit moves it
properties.formula: AG atom("when the import of the lowest unfinished record of a peer's feed commits, the cursor for that peer moves in the same commit to the highest peer visible_dt below which every pulled record is imported; no other commit moves it")

properties.name: Every record is eventually imported
properties.expression: once peers answer each other, every record held by any shard is imported, with its blob, by every shard
properties.formula: AF atom("once peers answer each other, every record held by any shard is imported, with its blob, by every shard")

tasks.interaction_mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Shard
    participant Peer
    Shard->>Peer: BlobRequest
    alt choice 1
    Peer->>Shard: BlobResponse
    else alternative
    Peer->>Shard: BlobMissing
    else alternative
    Shard->>Shard: PeerTimedOut
    end
    loop repeat
    Shard->>Peer: BlobRequest
    alt choice 1
    Peer->>Shard: BlobResponse
    else alternative
    Peer->>Shard: BlobMissing
    else alternative
    Shard->>Shard: PeerTimedOut
    end
    end
tasks.state_mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> queued
    queued --> fetching: BlobRequest
    fetching --> fetching: BlobResponse
    fetching --> imported: BlobResponse
    fetching --> deferred: BlobMissing
    fetching --> deferred: PeerTimedOut
    imported --> [*]
    deferred --> [*]
